text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos is an Umamusume who longs for the 
celebrity lifestyle and dreams of running 
in Dubai. However, she had another goal as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Namely, to take the Tiara route, win the 
Triple Tiara, and avenge her elder sister, 
Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering her frail build compared to 
her peers, the decision was made to focus 
on physical conditioning alongside her 
regular training.
